summary: IDF eliminated two Hamas Nukhba operatives in Gaza who participated in the October 7 Nir Oz raid and were preparing new attacks in violation of the ceasefire. Israeli forces concluded an 11-day Hebron operation that displaced thousands and seized weapons following a deadly checkpoint shooting. Trump signaled potential strikes on Iran as diplomacy stalls, while maritime tensions rise in the Strait of Hormuz with vessel distress calls and UKMTO warnings.

sections.executive_summary: IDF eliminated two Hamas Nukhba operatives in Gaza who participated in the October 7 Nir Oz raid and were preparing new attacks in violation of the ceasefire. Israeli forces concluded an 11-day Hebron operation that displaced thousands and seized weapons following a deadly checkpoint shooting. Trump signaled potential strikes on Iran as diplomacy stalls, while maritime tensions rise in the Strait of Hormuz with vessel distress calls and UKMTO warnings.

points: Trump is considering additional strikes against Iran as diplomatic efforts stall, per The Atlantic reporting, and discussed Iran with Netanyahu during a Saturday phone call. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9311, @Faytuks_Network/9309)
IRGC-affiliated Telegram channels and Tasnim news agency report massive explosions in Kuwait, though no official confirmations have emerged. (Source: @shin_persian/11866)
Two missiles were observed being transported in Isfahan at the Shahin Shahr entrance, escorted by two IRGC vehicles, indicating possible missile deployment or readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/11880)
Jet activity was heard in Sanandaj, Kurdistan Province, Iran, suggesting heightened air operations or patrols in the western region. (Source: @shin_persian/11881)
Iranian official Bakai stated that if Iran's demands are met, security could be restored to the Strait of Hormuz and negotiations could begin, contingent on US actions. (Source: @N12chat/232877)

IDF announced the killing of two Hamas Nukhba operatives in separate Gaza strikes: Mohammed Kamel Maslih Qdeih in Khan Younis, who raided Nir Oz on October 7, and Diaa Abdel Mohsen Mohammed Abu al-Rous in Nuseirat; both were advancing attacks on troops and civilians in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59459)

Israeli forces withdrew from several Hebron neighborhoods after an 11-day operation launched in response to an October 23 checkpoint shooting that killed two soldiers; the raid displaced thousands, detained dozens, captured three firearms, and demolished structures. (Source: @manniefabian/59462)

IDF forces in the West Bank scanned hundreds of locations, arrested and interrogated dozens of suspects, seized four weapons, vests, and military equipment, and sealed an underground space near a terrorist's home. (Source: @N12chat/232882)
A Hermes 450 drone was observed over Beirut and the southern Dahiyeh at 6,500 feet since 9 AM with two pods under its wings, operating below cloud cover. (Source: @redlinkleb/51254)
Extreme Haredi protesters blocked the Jerusalem light rail over the arrest of a draft dodger; police dispersed them using stun grenades. (Source: @yediotnews25/137124)
Residents in Rahat reported approximately four hours of continuous gunfire overnight continuing into the morning. (Source: @yediotnews25/137132)
Multiple reports indicate Israeli warplane activity in the south via live mapping, though specific details are not provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/51223, @redlinkleb/51232, @redlinkleb/51229)

Two Hamas Nukhba operatives were killed in Gaza strikes: one in Khan Younis (Mohammed Kamel Maslih Qdeih, involved in the October 7 Nir Oz raid) and one in Nuseirat (Diaa Abdel Mohsen Mohammed Abu al-Rous); both were restoring Hamas capabilities and violating the ceasefire. (Source: @manniefabian/59459)

Israeli forces completed an 11-day operation in Hebron, withdrawing after displacing thousands of residents, detaining dozens of suspects, capturing three firearms, and demolishing homes of the gunmen responsible for the October 23 checkpoint attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59462)

An IDF operation in the West Bank involved scanning hundreds of buildings, arresting and interrogating dozens of suspects, seizing four weapons, vests, and military equipment, and sealing an underground facility near a terrorist's residence. (Source: @N12chat/232882)
Residents in Rahat reported roughly four hours of uninterrupted gunfire during the night, with shooting continuing into the morning hours. (Source: @yediotnews25/137132)

A distress call from a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz reported casualties over radio, indicating a maritime security incident. (Source: @shin_persian/11878)
UKMTO issued Warning 190-26 (Update 001) and Warning 191-26 for maritime security in the region, signaling elevated threat levels for shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/11868, @shin_persian/11869)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous elimination of Hamas Nukhba operatives in Gaza and the conclusion of a major Hebron operation indicate sustained Israeli pressure on Hamas infrastructure in both territories. Trump's consideration of strikes on Iran and reported missile movements in Isfahan suggest escalating kinetic risks, while unconfirmed explosions in Kuwait and Strait of Hormuz distress signals point to potential maritime escalation. The Hermes 450 drone over Beirut signals persistent Israeli surveillance over Hezbollah strongholds. Domestic unrest in Rahat and Shefa-Amr adds internal security dimensions.
sections.regional_response: Iran's Bakai links Strait of Hormuz security to US compliance with Iranian demands, framing maritime safety as diplomatic leverage. UKMTO warnings reflect international concern over Gulf shipping lanes. Israeli political leadership faces domestic protests and judicial scrutiny over election integrity, potentially affecting wartime decision-making. Palestinian media reports Hebron withdrawal but IDF has not confirmed, indicating information gaps.
sections.intelligence_notes: The killing of Mohammed Kamel Maslih Qdeih, directly tied to the Nir Oz raid, demonstrates precise Israeli targeting of Oct 7 perpetrators. The 11-day Hebron operation's scale—hundreds of buildings scanned, thousands displaced—reveals intensive counter-terrorism methodology. Unverified IRGC channel reports of Kuwait explosions require cautious monitoring given historical pattern of disinformation. The Sanandaj jet activity and Isfahan missile transport may indicate Iranian air defense readiness or missile deployment.
